shortDescription: NetApp Cloud Manager connector for Azure.

options.name: account_id
options.description: The NetApp tenancy account ID.

options.name: admin_password
options.description: The password for the Connector.

options.name: admin_username
options.description: The user name for the Connector.

options.name: associate_public_ip_address
options.description: Indicates whether to associate the public IP address to the virtual machine.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The unique client ID of the Connector. The connector ID.

options.name: company
options.description: The name of the company of the user.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: location
options.description: The location where the Cloud Manager Connector will be created.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Cloud Manager connector for Azure to manage.

options.name: network_security_group_name
options.description: The name of the security group for the deployment.

options.name: network_security_resource_group
options.description: The resource group in Azure associated with the security group. If not provided, its assumed that the security group is within the previously specified resource group.

options.name: proxy_certificates
options.description: The proxy certificates, a list of certificate file names.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: The proxy password, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: proxy_url
options.description: The proxy URL, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: proxy_user_name
options.description: The proxy user name, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: The resource group in Azure where the resources will be created.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified Cloud Manager connector for Azure should exist or not.

options.name: storage_account
options.description: The storage account can be created automatically. When C(storage_account) is not set, the name is constructed by appending 'sa' to the connector C(name). Storage account name must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.

options.name: subnet_name
options.description: The name of the subnet for the virtual machine. For example, in /subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/xxx/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/xxx/subnets/default, only default is needed.

options.name: subscription_id
options.description: The ID of the Azure subscription.

options.name: virtual_machine_size
options.description: The virtual machine type. (for example, Standard_DS3_v2). At least 4 CPU and 16 GB of memory are required.

options.name: vnet_name
options.description: The name of the virtual network. for example, in /subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/xxx/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/default, only default is needed.

options.name: vnet_resource_group
options.description: The resource group in Azure associated with the virtual network. If not provided, its assumed that the VNet is within the previously specified resource group.
